name: real script PowerShell parser ref arguments
source:
param([string] $Source)
$tokens = $null
$errors = $null
$ast = [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseInput(
    $Source,
    [ref] $tokens,
    [ref] $errors
)
foreach ($error in $errors) {
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Id = $error.ErrorId
        Message = $error.Message
        Start = $error.Extent.StartOffset
        End = $error.Extent.EndOffset
    }
}
$ast.FindAll({ param($node) $node -is [System.Management.Automation.Language.CommandAst] }, $true)

real script filesystem report with continuations
source:
[CmdletBinding()]
param([string] $Root = '.', [string] $Output = 'report.csv')
$records = Get-ChildItem `
    -LiteralPath $Root `
    -Recurse `
    -File |
    Where-Object {
        $_.Extension -in '.ps1', '.psm1', '.psd1'
    } |
    Select-Object Name, Length, @{ Name = 'Directory'; Expression = { $_.DirectoryName } }
$records |
    Sort-Object Directory, Name |
    Export-Csv -LiteralPath $Output -NoTypeInformation

}
